statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-115506: Expat's billion laughs protection (accountingDiffTolerated in lib/xmlparse.c) detected entity amplification too late, so a moderately sized document with a large DTD and nested entity expansions could use tens of seconds of CPU per parse; the CVE record lists libexpat through 2.9.0 as affected (https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-115506). Upstream fixed it in Expat 2.10.0 by precomputing entity expansion sizes (libexpat pull requests #1433, #1436, #1439 and #1442, https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/pull/1433; release notes https://github.com/libexpat/libexpat/blob/R_2_10_0/expat/Changes). Alpine's aports expat APKBUILD lists the fix under 2.10.0-r0 (https://gitlab.alpinelinux.org/alpine/aports/-/blob/3.23-stable/main/expat/APKBUILD). The DHI Alpine 3.23 repository publishes expat builds 2.7.3-r0, 2.7.4-r0, 2.7.5-r0, 2.8.1-r0, 2.8.2-r0, 2.8.3-r0, 2.8.3-r1, 2.8.4-r0, 2.8.5-r0, 2.8.5-r1, 2.9.0-r1 and 2.10.0-r1, built from aports. We checked the libexpat and expat-static packages of every one of these builds for x86_64 and aarch64 against the index checksum: libexpat.so.1 and libexpat.a report Expat 2.7.3 to 2.9.0 in the builds before 2.10.0-r1 and Expat 2.10.0 in 2.10.0-r1, and only the 2.10.0-r1 files contain the assertion text '! blocker->beingAnalyzed' from the entity-size precomputation this fix adds, while the ' ABORTING' accounting text that older releases already had is present in every build. The xmlwf program in the expat package links libexpat.so.1 dynamically. No build before 2.10.0-r1 carries a backport of this fix. The range ends at 2.10.0-r1, the first published build with the fix.
